ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the types of schemes and the players involved.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?

ideas.insight: This story could help shed light on the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and identify areas for improvement in the state's oversight and enforcement efforts.
